start.description: On September 25, 2026 my landlord handed me a 3-day notice saying I owe $1,300 for September rent and I have to pay in cash only by September 30, 2026 or leave. I always pay by check and he's never asked for cash before. I didn't pay because I didn't have the cash. Yesterday, September 30, 2026, someone served me with court papers for eviction. I live in Gainesville, Alachua County. I have not paid any part of it since, and I am not holding back rent over repairs.

chat: Can he make me pay in cash only?
Has a court ever said anything about a notice that says cash only?
Do I have to put money into the court to fight this? What have judges said about that?

turns.say: Can he make me pay in cash only
